Case Recs for iPhone 14 Pro Max and iPhone 14

I want a super protective case for my new phone. I have typically used otterbox cases in the past. However, I’d love a case that is both cute and protective. Phone case needs to be Durable, protective, cute, and magsafe. I want to be able to add my popsocket on the back. Here are the brands I was looking at: 🍀Casetify - but then I read some bad reviews 🍀Caudable - but no cute colors or designs. Thank you for the recommendations! 7

Don’t know what the bad reviews are saying but I’ve had a Casetify case on my phone for over a year. No problems at all with it. I’ve dropped my phone multiple times and the case isn’t even dinged. The graphics on the case are still bright and are not scratched. I don’t use magsafe but I do have a ring holder attached.

Thank you! That helps me feel better! They have the cutest cases by far! Basically I saw a tiktok where the person’s case separated from the bumper and they hadn’t even dropped it! Casetify took over a month to replace it and tell them that they don’t carry their case anymore

I just got my new 14 pro max about a month ago and I got a casetify case for it. The ultra drop resistance one I don’t remember the name but it’s the best one they offer. I honestly love it. My ONLY complaint is that the camera bump is SLIGHTLY too short for my liking. It’s sits maybe 2 millimeters lower than my lens protector. I’m talking, just a hair man. I somehow managed to break the lens protector within the first week, but haven’t had any issues since then and that was 3 weeks ago.

Applecare

I’ve tried many cases, most recently the Mous cases that are often recommended, but nothing comes close in my opinion that Rhinoshield cases. These fit very snuggly and feel so great in the hand, something most brands solidly miss. For something you hold so long, you’d think brands would spend more time in how it feels in the hand. 100% Rhinoshield, it may be the last case brand I ever use.

Thank you so much! They have so many cute options OH MY GOODNESS!! I’ll definitely be considering these!!

I just got my aramid fiber one in the mail today and I love the feel of it. However I have the 13PM

Check out the OtterBox Core Series . They aren’t bulky like monster OtterBoxes, they’re 50% recycled if you care, and could be considered cute to some lol. My wife has a white one in her 13 Mini and it looks like a jawbreaker. I just got a black one for my 14 Pro Max. The speckles are different on each case. They’re rubbery but not as sticky as silicone. They’re also not as flexible as a regular TPU/rubber case - when it’s off the phone, it doesn’t flex much. Great case so far. FYI that case is only on OtterBoxes site and Apple.com from what I’ve seen. Also it looks like it currently has 2/5 stars on their site but the reviewers are just mad that they didn’t like the color options available?? So not a review on the actual product? Lol

Watch everythingapplepros video on cases for this year

Mous limitless 5.0

Spigen’s Ultrathin has never failed me before

Nomad leather is solid. Clicky buttons and nice leather back.

Nomad leather and /or rugged cases. Great fit. Buttons. Look great. MagSafe.
